build_SequenceGenerator: build a SequenceGenerator with an ensemble of fairseq models and a target dictionary for beam search translation
run_SequenceGenerator_forward: run the SequenceGenerator forward method to generate a batch of translations from a source sample
run_SequenceGenerator_generate: run the SequenceGenerator generate method to produce translations with optional prefix tokens and constraints
create_EnsembleModel: create an EnsembleModel wrapper around a list of fairseq models for ensemble inference with incremental decoding
build_SequenceGeneratorWithAlignment: build a SequenceGeneratorWithAlignment to generate translations with hard or soft source-target word alignments
